concept: Lambda: reserved concurrency as a concurrency limiter
tests: Distinguishing reserved from provisioned concurrency: which setting caps maximum concurrent executions.
expected: Reserved concurrency is a hard ceiling on the function's concurrent executions, protecting the downstream RDS. Triggers: "too many invocations at once", "limits how many concurrent executions", "downstream overwhelmed".
why_not: Provisioned concurrency pre-warms environments but does not cap the maximum; memory size affects CPU and cost; SQS visibility timeout controls redelivery, not concurrency.
